Hello Alex,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the webhook timeout issue.

Our platform enforces an outbound HTTP request timeout of 10 seconds and a maximum webhook payload limit of 2MB per event dispatch. If your listener takes longer than 10 seconds or sends payloads over 2MB, our gateway drops the connection with an HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout.

To resolve this:
1. Filter non-essential fields from your webhook payload.
2. Return an immediate HTTP 200 OK acknowledgment from your receiver before starting async background processing.

Please let us know if you need assistance configuring payload filters!

Best regards,
Developer Relations Team

1. Configure event filtering in your Webhook settings to omit large nested object graphs.
